أرتضي (form VIII)
# أَرْتَضِي (ʔartaḍī) /ʔar.ta.dˤiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# أَرْتَضِيَ (ʔartaḍiya) /ʔar.ta.dˤi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
